integrity: Geometric finite reduction and an independently executable, outward-rounded exact rational interval enumeration of all 511 admissible support configurations; no claim of independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the regular heptagon with chord directions only; no general Kuperberg conjecture or unrestricted enclosure theorem. The rational 1/40 gap is not optimal. Historical-priority risk from unindexed regular-polygon calculations remains.
title: Exact chord-quadrilateral enclosure and rigid support gaps of the regular heptagon
